projects.name: Heron Labs — Agami
projects.description:
**Problem.** Fixed sampling locations leave gaps in our picture of changing river conditions.

**Solution.** Agami is a semi-autonomous surface vessel that collects GPS-tagged nitrate, conductivity, turbidity and temperature measurements while travelling through waterways.

**My contribution.** I co-founded Heron Labs and led major parts of Agami's technical development: the analogue and embedded sensing stack, ESP32 firmware, LTE/GNSS telemetry, GPS navigation, web-based monitoring, electronics integration and iterative field testing.

projects.name: Edith Glasses
projects.description: Bone conduction glasses merging hearing aid functionality with wireless audio. 3D-printed custom casing integrating PCB from repurposed AirPods for seamless audio experience.

projects.name: Red-light Green-light
projects.description: Real-life recreation of the Squid Game challenge using computer vision. Revised C++ vision training model to run on ESP32, tracking player movement during 'red light' phases. Integrated with custom laser tag vest that activates when motion is detected. Built in 32-hour hackathon.
